map.婚前/婚内约定财产归属，按双方比例拆分各项财产金额。: Agree on property ownership before or during marriage, then split each asset amount by the two parties' ratios.
map.核对男女方比例合计是否为 100%，避免分配漏洞。: Check that the two parties' ratios sum to 100% to avoid gaps in the allocation.

map.婚内财产协议有效吗？: Is a marital property agreement valid?
map.有效，夫妻可约定婚内及婚前财产归属；涉及不动产建议办理公证或登记以增强对抗力。: Valid; spouses may agree on the ownership of marital and premarital property; for real estate, notarization or registration is advised to strengthen enforceability.
map.比例必须写整数吗？: Must the ratio be an integer?
map.不必，可约定任意比例甚至特定财产归一方；工具仅校验合计为 100% 便于核对。: Not necessarily; you can agree on any ratio, or assign specific property to one party; the tool only checks that the shares total 100% for easy verification.
